checkpoints.description: pass 2: Track C task with no plan checkpoint

impact_assessment.why: a Track C task that never records a plan bypasses the impact check entirely
impact_assessment.benefits: the skipped step is visible instead of silent
impact_assessment.risks: contract: --checkpoint may print a warning on stderr; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: warning, not refusal, so Track B is unaffected; unit test
